name: age
rationale: Age of the subject at sampling. 'age at draw' belongs here because the draw is the sampling event.

name: age at dissection
rationale: D59..D136. Fetal samples count from conception and organoids from the start of culture, so not pooled with postnatal age.

name: developmental stage
rationale: fetus.

name: specimen source
rationale: What the specimen was derived from: primary fetal tissue, stem-cell-derived organoids, cell lines.

name: cell line
rationale: Values are named lines (K562, AG05397, par/dis): each is a cultured cell, coarse but well formed (iteration 2 decision 8.3).

name: karyotype
rationale: Chromosome-21 complement: WT/Trisomy 21, T21/D21, Euploid/TS21/TS13, trisomic/disomic.

name: Down syndrome status
rationale: Records only the presence of Down syndrome.

name: congenital abnormality
rationale: None / Downs / Other / Unknown (iteration 2 decision 4.8).

name: cohort
rationale: Study, registry or consortium a sample came from.

name: batch
rationale: EFO:0005067 is defined as 'a block or batch'.

name: replicate
rationale: Replicate number.

name: comparison group
rationale: Iteration 2 decision 4.8.

name: library type
rationale: strand-specific.

name: pooled or single sample
rationale: pooled organoids / single organoid.

name: Braak stage
rationale: Iteration 2 gold: disease staging.

name: cause of death
rationale: No adequate term (iteration 2 gold).

name: BCR-ABL1 t(9;22) status
rationale: EFO has no BCR-ABL1 fusion term, only diseases defined by it.

name: MLL rearrangement status
rationale: MLL rearrangements in ALL are almost always translocations.

name: FLT3-ITD status
rationale: EFO:0004015 duplication: 'part of the genome is duplicated'.

name: CNS status
rationale: Degree of central nervous system involvement (CNS1-3), a leukaemia staging element.

name: testicular involvement
rationale: No term for testicular involvement by leukaemia.

name: white blood cell count
rationale: EFO:0004308 leukocyte count is deprecated in v3.94.0 (iteration 2 decision 6a.5); complete blood cell count + leukocyte expresses it without the deprecated term.

name: blast count
rationale: -1 marks missing.

name: sample viability
rationale: -1 marks missing.

name: training or test set
rationale: Analysis artefact.

name: CRLF2 expression (qRT-PCR)
rationale: Different method and scale from the array values, so a different variable.

name: CRLF2 FISH result
rationale: Deletion / IGH@-CRLF2 / Normal.

name: genetic aberration
rationale: TEL-AML1 / High Hyperdiploid / BCR-ABL / MLL / E2A-PBX1.

name: SNP dataset
rationale: Co-occurs with 'gene expression dataset', so it cannot join cohort.
